title: Add assimilate-current-project consumer variant; scope hivemind-assimilate-skill to framework without breaking design-pack
description: Give consumer projects a local-only skill-adoption entry point, mirroring the framework/-current-project split from TASK-153, but handle the design-pack entanglement deliberately. Context (investigation): hivemind-assimilate-skill already documents two invocation paths (dev-repo bin/*.js vs plugin-install dist/pack-ctl.cjs, SKILL.md lines ~47/60-65) and is referenced in prose by the CONSUMER-facing commands/design-pack.md (lines ~72/77/82/104-107). So unlike the hive-* skills, assimilate already has a consumer path and a consumer caller — a naive relocation would break design-pack for consumers.\n\nDeliver: (1) author skills/assimilate-current-project in plugin-root skills/ (shipped to consumers) as the consumer-facing adoption skill — adopts a third-party skill into the CONSUMER'S OWN project only, using the dist/pack-ctl.cjs path, keeping the human-gated security-reviewer + sign-off protocol intact. Inverse guard: if isFrameworkRepo (TASK-152) is TRUE, point to hivemind-assimilate-skill. (2) Keep hivemind-assimilate-skill available (it is the framework-repo path); add a guard/prose note that in a consumer project the -current-project variant is the right entry. Decide + implement the minimal treatment that KEEPS design-pack's consumer flow working — either keep hivemind-assimilate-skill in plugin skills/ too (both shipped) or repoint design-pack.md to assimilate-current-project; whichever the developer chooses, design-pack's documented consumer flow must still resolve to a real, shipped skill. (3) Update the TASK-153 two-channel sensor to include assimilate-current-project in the consumer-shipped set and reflect wherever hivemind-assimilate-skill ends up. tdd: packaging + human-gated-security-surface; run test:all. Preserve all existing assimilate security invariants (default-deny verdict gate, license-not-safety, no auto-adopt).
acceptance_criteria: skills/assimilate-current-project exists in plugin-root skills/, scoped to adopt a skill into the consumer's own project only, preserving the human-gated security-reviewer verdict + explicit sign-off (default-deny) and the license-is-decision-support-not-safety rule
assimilate-current-project guard-stops + points to hivemind-assimilate-skill when isFrameworkRepo is true

commands/design-pack.md's consumer-facing assimilate step still resolves to a real shipped skill (either hivemind-assimilate-skill remains shipped, or the command is repointed to assimilate-current-project) — verified by reading the command + confirming the referenced skill ships in plugin-root skills/
hivemind-assimilate-skill notes/guards that in a consumer project the -current-project variant is the correct entry
tests/plugin-scaffold.spec.js two-channel sensor updated to include assimilate-current-project (consumer-shipped) and reflect hivemind-assimilate-skill's channel
No regression to existing assimilate security specs; npm run test:all green

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: DONE — assimilate-current-project (consumer-shipped, plugin skills/) split out from hivemind-assimilate-skill (now framework-only, .claude/skills/), with inverse/framework guards and a full consumer-facing reference sweep. Single commit 14ceebf (tdd single-commit: sensor + assimilate-skill.spec rewritten first, 10 right-reason red failures captured, then skill authored + relocation + reference repoint to green). Reviewer verdict: APPROVE at review_depth=FULL (rubric inputs: packaging + test-infra change on a human-gated SECURITY surface + cross-repo reference sweep). 0 HIGH, 0 MEDIUM, 0 LOW. Reviewer independently confirmed the two highest risks: (1) all three security invariants preserved verbatim in intent in the consumer variant (default-deny 'safe'-only verdict gate, license-is-decision-support-not-safety, no auto-adopt without human sign-off, assimilation carved out of every loop_auth grant) — only surface adaptations (dist/pack-ctl.cjs path vs bin/*.js), no weakening; (2) reference sweep COMPLETE — independent grep found every consumer-facing reference (commands/design-pack.md ×4, both security-reviewer.md copies, both orchestrator-routing copies) isFrameworkRepo-gated and routing consumers to the shipped assimilate-current-project; no dangling consumer pointer. Both guards present as executable prose; channels + byte-identical parity (orchestrator-routing ×2, security-reviewer ×2) confirmed; sensor + assimilate-skill.spec non-vacuous. Gate: npm run test:all 1750 passed/4 skipped (dist-parity + use-cases green); test:since non-zero green. Note: the 154 developer already added the assimilate-specific piece of the framework-vs-current-project convention to orchestrator-routing, shrinking TASK-155's remaining scope. No HIGH, no RC loop → no knowledge draft.
